description: 2x KUKA KR240 R2900-2 stick-tool robots, 15 spot welds of the synthetic car-door program (no door CAD exists in the repo; the 3x5 grid is synthetic). 11 welds sit on the 3x5 grid at z=1.35 (columns x = -1.15 / -0.975 / -0.8, rows y = -1.8 / -1.5125 / -1.225 / -0.9375 / -0.65). W10, W13, W14, W15 are PLACEHOLDERS moved off the grid for the GEO_FIXTURE_OP1000 fixture of welding_cell_2t (this cell has no fixture); keep them until CAD values exist. 'orientation' is the vertical (tool-down) transit orientation; 'weld_orientation' is the required TCP orientation at the weld. The central column is vertical; the two outer columns lean 45 deg about world y, with the tool body outboard and the electrode pointing inboard-down. Corrected copy, see ERRATA.md.

cycle_time.note: original targets kept; unvalidated: umarell's plans need 76.9 s, the fastest controller in this project 26.7 s (env clock)

weld_params.note: approach/retract offsets are along approach_vector (were approach_offset_z/retract_offset_z = 0.05, read by no umarell code; umarell executes its 0.10 m default). dwell_s is the executed hold (umarell executor hold_duration_s 0.5). welding_duration_s and weld_phases (0.1 + 2.0 + 0.1 s) are the original process spec, NOT executed by umarell; set scene planning.dwell_s to 2.2 to honour them (ERRATA.md E9).

conventions.units: metres, world frame of the cell (z up, floor at z=0); quaternions xyzw
conventions.approach_vector: UNIT direction in which the TCP TRAVELS INTO the weld point (descent direction). [0,0,-1] = come down from above. The pre-weld standoff is position - approach_vector * approach_offset_m; the lift-off goes the opposite way, position - approach_vector * retract_offset_m. It does NOT point away from the surface (umarell's skills/*/optimize-sequence/references/operation-params.md:27,35 say so; the planner code does the opposite, see ERRATA.md E6).
conventions.weld_orientation: orientation of the TCP frame (tip_link frame translated by tcp_offset, no rotation) in the world at the weld; the tool axis is the TCP frame -x, i.e. -R[:,0]
conventions.orientation: tool-down transit orientation (informational; umarell's RRT keeps it between welds)
conventions.gates: position <= 10 mm, tool axis <= 5 deg (spin about the axis is free), entry direction over the last 0.04 m <= 15 deg from approach_vector (umarell validate_approach)
conventions.liftoff: after the dwell, a straight on-axis lift-off of retract_offset_m along -approach_vector at the weld orientation is REQUIRED before any transit (ERRATA.md E7)
conventions.placeholder: true = position is not from CAD (replace with the CAD value); original_position is the grid point
